summary: 寒门起家，讨桓玄复晋室，灭南燕、破卢循、灭后秦，武功冠于南朝；永初元年受禅称帝，国号宋，为南朝第一帝。
summary_en: Rising from a common house, he destroyed Huan Xuan to restore the Jin, then destroyed Southern Yan, broke Lu Xun, and ended Later Qin — arms without equal in the southern dynasties; in the 1st year of Yongchu he received the abdication and founded Song, first emperor of the Southern Dynasties.

portrait.appearance_basis: 宋书载「帝身长七尺六寸，风骨奇特」。画像宜表现寒门起家的雄主之态，衣冠从刘宋初制。属艺术想象。

timeline.title: 生京口
timeline.summary: 彭城人侨居京口，字德舆，小字寄奴。家贫，以农耕渔樵为业。
timeline.summary_en: A man of Pengcheng settled at Jingkou, styled Deyu, childhood name Jinu; poor, he farmed, fished, and cut wood.

timeline.title: 起兵讨桓玄
timeline.summary: 与刘毅、何无忌等起兵京口，平桓玄，迎安帝复辟。
timeline.summary_en: With Liu Yi, He Wuji, and the others he rose at Jingkou, destroyed Huan Xuan, and restored Emperor An.

timeline.title: 灭南燕
timeline.summary: 北伐灭慕容超，克广固，屠其城。
timeline.summary_en: He campaigned north, destroyed Murong Chao, took Guanggu, and massacred the city.

timeline.title: 破卢循
timeline.summary: 卢循逼建康，裕还救，大破之。
timeline.summary_en: Lu Xun pressed Jiankang; Yu hurried back and broke him utterly.

timeline.title: 北伐启行
timeline.summary_en: He set out from Jiankang against Later Qin.

timeline.title: 灭后秦
timeline.summary: 入长安，姚泓降，留子义真镇关中，旋失。
timeline.summary_en: He entered Chang'an; Yao Hong surrendered; leaving his son Yizhen to hold Guanzhong, it was soon lost.

timeline.title: 受禅称帝
timeline.summary: 晋恭帝禅位，裕即皇帝位，国号宋，改元永初。
timeline.summary_en: Emperor Gong of Jin abdicated; Yu took the throne, styled the realm Song, and changed the era to Yongchu.

timeline.title: 武帝崩
timeline.summary: 崩于西殿，年六十；少帝义符继。
timeline.summary_en: He died in the western hall at sixty; the Young Emperor Yifu succeeded.

timeline.title: 土断与集权
timeline.summary: 义熙土断、抑制豪强，为「元嘉之治」张本。
timeline.summary_en: The Yixi registration and the checking of the powerful prepared the Yuanjia recovery.

timeline.title: 武帝总评
timeline.summary: 史称奇才远略，功百晋宣；然性猜忌，功臣多不终。
timeline.summary_en: The histories call him a rare genius of far-seeing strategy, his merit a hundred times Sima Yi's; but he was jealous, and few of his功臣 came to good end.

relations.note_en: Yongchu 1: receives the throne by abdication from Emperor Gong of Jin

relations.note: 永初三年崩，太子义符即位
relations.note_en: Yongchu 3: dies; Crown Prince Yifu takes the throne

meta.inclusion_reason: 刘宋开国皇帝，正史立纪。

bio_md:
# 宋武帝 · 主要事迹

刘裕字德舆，小字寄奴，彭城人，侨居京口。出身寒微，「布衣起家，实由武功」：初为北府兵将，元兴三年与刘毅、何无忌等起兵京口，讨平桓玄，迎晋安帝复辟——「再造晋室」之功，实自裕始。

义熙年间，刘裕总揽朝政，武功极盛：义熙五年北伐南燕，克广固、斩慕容超；义熙六年回师破卢循、徐道覆，保建康；义熙十二年北伐后秦，次年入长安，姚泓出降——五胡以来沦陷的中原，一度光复。然留子义真镇关中，旋为赫连勃勃所夺，「得而复失」。义熙土断、抑制豪强，为南朝集权张本。

永初元年，晋恭帝禅位，刘裕即皇帝位，国号宋，改元永初——晋亡宋立，南朝自此始。永初三年，裕崩于西殿，年六十。史称裕「奇才远略，功百晋宣」；然性猜忌，「功臣多不终」，杀刘毅、诸葛长民等。刘裕以寒门之身取天下，终结门阀政治之垄断，南朝以降，「王与马共天下」之局遂变为「寒人掌机要」——其开国规模，实为南朝之最。

> 参考：点校本《宋书》卷001《武帝纪》、卷002《武帝纪中》。

bio_parts_en.value:
Liu Yu, styled Deyu, childhood name Jinu, was a man of Pengcheng settled at Jingkou. Of common birth, "he rose from the cloth and took the realm by arms": a general of the Northern Garrison, in the 3rd year of Yuanxing he rose at Jingkou with Liu Yi and He Wuji, destroyed Huan Xuan, and restored Emperor An — the "re-founding of the Jin house" was his work.

In the Yixi years, holding the government, he reached the height of arms: in the 5th year he destroyed Southern Yan, taking Guanggu and beheading Murong Chao; in the 6th he hurried back to break Lu Xun and Xu Daofu and save Jiankang; in the 12th he campaigned against Later Qin, entering Chang'an the next year as Yao Hong surrendered — the Central Plains, lost to the barbarians, were recovered for a moment. But his son Yizhen, left to hold Guanzhong, was soon driven out by Helian Bobo: "won and lost again." His registration of the displaced and his checking of the powerful prepared the centralization of the southern courts.

In the 1st year of Yongchu Emperor Gong of Jin abdicated; Yu took the throne, styled the realm Song, and changed the era — Jin fell, Song rose, and the Southern Dynasties began. He died in the western hall in the 3rd year of Yongchu at sixty. The histories call him "a rare genius of far-seeing strategy, his merit a hundred times Sima Yi's"; but he was jealous, and "few of his meritorious ministers came to a good end" — Liu Yi, Zhuge Changmin, and the rest were slain. A common man who took the realm, he broke the great clans' monopoly; the age of "Wang and Sima sharing the realm" gave way to the ascendancy of the humble — his founding measures were the greatest of the Southern Dynasties.

> References: the punctuated critical edition of the *Songshu*, ch. 1 and 2 ("Benji of Emperor Wu").
